0022600176.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-5) visit the 1-6 Brooklyn Nets in the Hornets' ninth game of the season, with Charlotte on a four-game losing streak and sitting 3rd in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, and 9th in the East. Brooklyn is 5th in the Atlantic, 5.5 games back, and 15th in the East, and is coming off a loss. Charlotte is missing Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel (both hamstring), while Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain).
